pairs.subject: prompt-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/lib/org/developer-view-load.ts:11 The Developer home is a read model filled from DB reads (contributor insights, the viewer's own mentor share) and rendered by client components; none of its listed files imports @/lib/llm or builds model input, and the terms systemPrompt/llmMaxTokens/runClaudePrompt have zero hits in its directories. Disclosure: src/lib/org does host other contexts' assemblers (briefing-narrative.ts, followups.ts buildFixPrompt), and those are not part of this context.

pairs.subject: prompt-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/components/onboarding/importScan.ts:5 The wizard only consumes the server's scan SSE stream (with a stall watchdog sized for a real LLM scan); prompt assembly happens server-side in the scanning pipeline. A case-insensitive 'prompt' search has zero hits in src/app/onboarding and src/components/onboarding. The only @/lib/llm import (PrivacyNotice.tsx) resolves the provider name for a disclosure and builds no prompt.

pairs.subject: prompt-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/features/inflight/live/fleetTimetable.ts:7 The War Room aligns stored scan histories into a timetable and renders panels; it neither calls nor assembles a model prompt. @/lib/llm/systemPrompt/llmMaxTokens/runClaudePrompt have zero hits in src/app/org/[slug]/live and src/features/inflight/live. The only 'prompt' words are two comments in the cockpit/ and theater/ subfolders, which are outside the listed files.

pairs.subject: prompt-assembly
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/gate/[owner]/[repo]/route.ts:11 The gate evaluates a policy over a finished ScanReport and posts checks/comments. It reaches a model only by delegating a cold scan to scanRepository, which is owned by the scanning context, and gate.ts, gate-comment.ts, checks.ts, write.ts and org-gate.ts import no LLM module. Disclosure: src/lib/scoring/prompt.ts (buildAssessmentPrompt) shares the directory but belongs to the scanning context. The 'prompts' in gate-comment.ts are human-facing exploration prompts in a PR comment.
